image_description: A side-profile view of a large American bison standing on a gravel path next to a grassy field. The animal has a massive, shaggy dark brown forequarter with a prominent shoulder hump and a lighter, less furred hindquarter. In the background, there are mountains and sparse trees under a blue sky.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large broad head with short curved horns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is visible in profile; it appears broad and massive. While the horns are partially obscured by the thick fur of the forehead, the general shape and size are consistent with a bison.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beard of long hair on chin and throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A distinct, shaggy beard hangs from the chin and throat area, matching the taxonomy description.
The eye is visible as a dark spot on the side of the head, consistent with the description.
Ears are not prominently sticking out; they appear small and blended into the heavy fur of the head/neck region.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Massive body with exceptionally tall, heavily built proportions at the withers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The animal exhibits the characteristic massive build and height at the shoulders typical of a bison.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Shaggy dark brown fur covering forequarters forming prominent shoulder hump.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The forequarters are covered in thick, dark, shaggy fur, creating a very distinct and prominent shoulder hump.
There is a clear visual transition where the fur becomes significantly shorter and smoother on the rear half of the body compared to the front.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short horns compared to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Although partially hidden by fur, the visible horn structure is short and curved, proportional to the massive head.

The legs appear sturdy and black/dark. While the ground contact point makes individual hoof separation hard to resolve perfectly, the overall structure and stance are anatomically correct for a bovid.
A short tail ending in a dark, bushy tuft is clearly visible hanging behind the hind legs.

alignment_reasoning: The image demonstrates perfect conformance to the 'bison' class. All diagnostic checkpoints regarding the head, body proportions, fur distribution (hump vs. hindquarters), and anatomy are clearly present and accurate. The subject is unmistakably a bison.
artifact_reasoning: No AI-generation artifacts were detected. The image exhibits natural lighting, realistic fur texture transitions, correct anatomical proportions, and coherent background geometry. There are no signs of melting, fusion, or structural anomalies.
